parts.lead: State, for an X-ray image, what is meant by:

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
A parallel X-ray beam passes through a thickness of 2.3 cm of soft body tissue. The intensity of the emerging beam is 12% of the intensity of the incident beam.

Calculate the linear attenuation (absorption) coefficient *μ* of the soft body tissue. Give a unit with your answer.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
In medical diagnosis, X-rays may be used to produce a single X-ray image or may be used in computed tomography (CT scanning).

Suggest an advantage and a disadvantage of CT scanning compared with single X-ray image for diagnosis.
